chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Beware of dealing with those who have defects, for they are the most unjust of things.

key_terms.شَيْءٍ: thing; anyone described in the broadest sense

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام teach about dealing with أصحاب العاهات?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام warns against entering dealings with people marked by serious defects of character or condition. The saying emphasizes caution in social and economic interactions because such people are described as especially prone to injustice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Beware of dealing with those who have defects, for they are the most unjust of people."
